mapper.insert: insert into student_violation_record (student_id, violation_type, violation_score, description) values (#{studentId}, #{violationType}, #{violationScore}, #{description})
mapper.select: select r.id, r.student_id, s.name as studentName, s.no as studentNo, r.violation_type, r.violation_score, r.violation_time, r.description from student_violation_record r left join student s on r.student_id = s.id where r.student_id = #{id} order by r.violation_time desc
